confidence_notes: Restaurant meal, cappuccino and draft-beer estimates come from aggregated Mumbai price tables. Cocktail is based on a small current cost-of-living sample; wine is estimated at about twice the draft-beer price because a comparable glass price was unavailable. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates and are less certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparator; Mumbai's high-cost major-metropolis profile within South Asia informs the holistic accommodation estimates.
